note: After Emerson's (1925) original description of the new species (in English), placed in the original under the subgenus Nasutitermes (Subulitermes), later assigned to Atlantitermes; the alate is described from one queen and the soldier from one colony. The author noted that this species is slightly larger than N. oculatissimus with smaller ocelli, that its compound eyes are much larger than in N. raripilus, and stated outright that he could "find no good distinguishing character" between it and N. raripilus, which could be separated only by the slightly smaller body size. The species name honours Henry Fairfield Osborn, president of the New York Zoological Society.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head dark brown, oval. Fontanelle pore slit-like, about as long as an ocellus. Muscle attachment scars rather distinct. Antennal segment 3 almost equal to segment 2, segment 4 longer than segment 2. Compound eyes very large and very close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli large, very close to the compound eyes. Postclypeus distinctly paler than the head, median suture clear. Pronotum paler than the head; sides slightly rounded, anterior corners rather acute, posterior margin nearly straight and slightly concave. Posterior margins of mesonotum and metanotum broadly concave. Abdominal tergites about the same colour as the pronotum.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head yellow, oval in dorsal view, with a small constriction behind the antennal bases, the lateral outline convex with only a slight depression in the middle; rostrum with 4 setae at the base and 2 on the vertex, no minute hairs. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 3 much smaller than segment 2, segment 2 equal to segment 4; segment 3 just separate from segment 4. Mandibles without a point. Rostrum brown, long and slender, not upturned in lateral view; small hairs at the rostral apex and the outer apical margin. Thorax pale. Abdomen coloured like the gut contents. Abdominal tergites with a row of setae at the posterior margin and covered with very minute hairs.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Alate (queen) measurements (mm): head length 1.17; head width 1.07; compound eye diameter 0.43; pronotum length 0.57, width 0.83; hind tibia length 1.44; queen body length 6.20. Soldier measurements (mm): body length 3.20—3.35; head length 1.30—1.33; head width 0.63—0.67; antennal length 1.27; pronotum width 0.40—0.41; hind tibia length 0.67—0.77. Type locality Cow Island (Bartica District), British Guiana, about six miles from Kartabo; holotype a queen, morphotype a soldier; described from one queen and numerous soldiers of the same colony.
